implementation.targetScope: Lazy, cached Podman marker and VPM Docker detection, with CJS/ESM entries and original-name CLI. The only runtime dependency is vis-docker.

differences: Uses vis-docker 4.0.0, adding mountinfo-only Docker evidence beyond upstream's is-docker 3 dependency.
A missing Podman marker uses nonthrowing stat; other filesystem failures fall through to Docker detection.
Adds a callable CommonJS entry, sharing the same cache with ESM.
Detection is heuristic, not a security boundary. No native Docker/Podman/WSL execution or application adoption is claimed.
